links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no reading-level instruction (nonprompted input), in both free and paywalled ChatGPT
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of chatbot cancer information responses
links.effect: Free chatbot: median 52.60 nonprompted vs 71.55 with sixth-grade prompt (P < .001). Paywalled chatbot: median 62.48 nonprompted vs 75.64 with prompt (P < .001). The prompted free version was easier to read than the nonprompted paywalled version. No significant difference in overall DISCERN quality scores with or without prompting.
links.quote: Prompting was associated with increases in reading ease in both free (median [IQR], 71.55 [68.20-78.99]; P < .001)and paywalled versions (median [IQR], 75.64 [70.53-81.12]; P < .001).
